name: Morpheus spring release A
question: Does a frozen damped model predict another release under the same-setup assumption? Evaluate y displacement in pixels; metric scale and hidden setup constants are not verified.

assumptions: Camera is assumed fixed and motion is assumed planar and parallel to the image plane for review.
Tracking is limited to the metal cylinder body in pixels, excluding hook and spring.
Vertical pixel position is the analysis signal along axis y.
Candidate motion is reviewed as oscillation with possible amplitude decay, without asserting cause.
plan.summary: Track vertical pixel position of the metal cylinder over time from this fixed-camera footage and review for y-axis oscillation versus damped oscillation in pixels only.
warnings: No physical scale is verified; use pixels only and do not infer dimensions.
Capture conditions are not authenticated; do not claim causes or precision.
Reflective surface and small image size may add tracking noise.
Hook and spring are excluded; connection point may occlude top of target.
Any lateral sway or rotation would be model mismatch for pure y model.
Camera motion and perspective have not been verified.
